avoid: Collisions while circling the central cloth
Overly vigorous flapping that compromises balance
children.game_version: A game where children pretend to be buzzards circling a cloth 'carrion', listening for sideline thigh claps to freeze or hop.

avoid: Excessive neck straining when looking down at the cloth
seniors.counts: Count in steady 4-beat phrases (shuffle 1-2-3, slight lift on 4).
seniors.seated_version: Perform seated while extending arms wide like bird wings, shuffling feet forward and back on the floor, accompanied by gentle thigh patting.
seniors.standing_version: Circle a floor marker at a gentle walking pace with extended arms, replacing the hop with a soft knee bend.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Perform at a comfortable, moderate pace with reduced arm extension if shoulder stiffness occurs.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms stretched wide to the sides, imitating buzzard wings.
movement_profile.footwork: A shuffle step combined with a small hop executed along a circular pathway.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circular floor path around a central piece of cloth representing carrion.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low level shuffle grounded near the floor punctuated by a small hop.
movement_profile.partnering: Solo dancer interacting with a central floor prop, surrounded by sideline participants.
movement_profile.posture: Upright or mimetic bird stance with arms fully outstretched to resemble birds of prey.

signature_moves.description: Circling with fully extended arms while executing a shuffle step punctuated by a small hop around central carrion.
signature_moves.name: Buzzard Wing Hop

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid modern theatrical exaggeration that strips away the specific comic hokum sensibility or the grounding shuffle step.

music_profile.sound_description: The sonic environment is characterized by communal body percussion, featuring coordinated hand-clapping and thigh-patting from sideline onlookers. It connects to Southern blues and folk traditions, famously referenced in the song 'Johnny Brown'.

basic_steps: Place a piece of cloth on the ground to establish the central point.
Extend both arms fully outward to imitate the outstretched wings of a buzzard.
Execute a low shuffle step moving along a circular path around the cloth.
Add a small hop into the shuffle while maintaining the arm extension and circular trajectory.
teaching.formation: Solo or individual dancer circling a central piece of cloth with observers on the sidelines.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on sustaining balance with outstretched arms while coordinating the shuffle and small hop in a tight circle.
teaching.rhythm: Accompanying rhythm marked by sideline hand-clapping and thigh-patting.
